'''Scratch''' is a yellow cat owned by [[Brandelwyn al'Vere]] that lives in the [[Winespring Inn]] in [[Emond's Field]].

==Appearance==
Scratch is a yellow tomcat.

==Activities==
Scratch usually sleeps in the common room of the Winespring Inn.{{ref/book|1|2}} He is sometimes startled by activities there{{ref/book|4|29}} and is often unnoticed by other people.{{ref/book|4|30}}
